presets.name: Pop Lead Polish
presets.intent: Modern pop lead: mud cut, presence, air, de-esser, plate.

presets.name: Rap Vocal Upfront
presets.intent: Rap vocal dry and loud in front: fast compression, presence, de-esser.

presets.name: Ballad Open Vocal
presets.intent: Open ballad vocal: gentle compression, air, hall.

presets.name: Trap Vocal Air
presets.intent: Trap lead: tight, bright, a 1/8D echo that ducks under the words.

presets.name: Rock Vocal Grit
presets.intent: Rock lead with Iron grit and a slapback.

presets.name: Soft Intimate Vocal
presets.intent: Close, soft vocal: warm, lightly compressed, small room.

presets.name: Radio Telephone Voice
presets.intent: Telephone / radio voice: band-limited and crushed (Germanium).

presets.name: Vintage Tube Vocal (Lenin)
presets.intent: Vintage lead: LA-style slow compression, tape, BRING LENIN BACK.

presets.name: Vocal Doubler Wide
presets.intent: Layers: layer 2 is a short pitched echo pushed wide - a natural double.

presets.name: Vocal Throw Layer
presets.intent: Layers: layer 2 is only reverb + 1/4 echo on the vocal's top band, ducked - a send in one preset.

presets.name: Stutter Vocal (Revolution)
presets.intent: HamloRevolution on the vocal: musical stutters and half-time moments.

presets.name: Ad-Lib Space
presets.intent: Ad-libs: band-limited, wide, ping-pong echo and a big plate.

presets.name: Vocal Dynamic Clarity
presets.intent: Dynamic EQ instead of static: mud and harsh bands move only when they stick out.

presets.name: Lo-Fi Bedroom Vocal
presets.intent: Lo-fi vocal: cassette, narrow, a dusty room.

presets.name: R&B Silk Vocal
presets.intent: R&B lead: silky top, smooth compression, a short plate and a 1/8 echo.

presets.name: Indie Room Vocal
presets.intent: Indie vocal: mid-forward, tape, a live room.

presets.name: Drill Vocal Tight
presets.intent: Drill vocal: very tight, upfront, bright, short 1/16 echo.

presets.name: Spoken Word Warm
presets.intent: Podcast / spoken word: warm, even, no reverb.

presets.name: Vocal Stalin Shout
presets.intent: Screams / shouts: STALIN and Iron, compressed hard.

presets.name: Vocal Big Hall Ballad
presets.intent: A big ballad: long hall with predelay, tape echo, de-esser before the space.

presets.name: Vocal Air Multiband
presets.intent: A region on the air band (8-16 kHz) compressed on its own, so the top stays smooth when it gets louder.

presets.name: Tuning Ready Vocal
presets.intent: A clean, dry, controlled vocal for pitch correction afterwards: no time effects.

presets.name: Vocal Half-Time Hook
presets.intent: Revolution TIME, CLEAN stretch: the hook drops to half time and back.

presets.name: Vocal Parallel Compression
presets.intent: Layers: the vocal lightly compressed, plus a crushed copy at 30 % - dense and present, the dynamics still there.

presets.name: Backing Pad Wide
presets.intent: Backing vocals pushed back and wide, darker than the lead.

presets.name: Gang Vocal Stack
presets.intent: Group shouts: dense compression, wide, room.

presets.name: Harmony Air
presets.intent: Harmonies airy and soft, behind the lead.

presets.name: Choir Cathedral
presets.intent: A choir in a cathedral.

presets.name: Backing Doubler
presets.intent: Layers: a pitched short double on layer 2, wide.

presets.name: Backing Tape Blend
presets.intent: Backing vocals glued with tape and Lenin.

presets.name: Backing Ping-Pong Air
presets.intent: Backing vocal echoes bouncing L-R, airy.

presets.name: Backing Lo-Fi Chorus
presets.intent: Lo-fi backing: cassette and a wide BBD shimmer.

presets.name: Backing Behind Lead
presets.intent: Backing vocal tucked behind the lead: presence cut where the lead lives.

presets.name: Backing Reverse Swells
presets.intent: Revolution reverses the backing line into a plate: swells into the next word.

presets.name: Acoustic Sparkle
presets.intent: Acoustic guitar: boom cut, sparkle, a small room.

presets.name: Electric Crunch Body
presets.intent: Electric rhythm: low mids even, Iron crunch.

presets.name: Clean Chorus Echo
presets.intent: Clean electric with BBD echo modulation (chorus-like) and a plate.

presets.name: Wide Rhythm
presets.intent: Rhythm guitar made wide (stereoize, mono-safe).

presets.name: Ambient Guitar Wash
presets.intent: Ambient guitar: long tape echo, cathedral, ducked.

presets.name: Guitar Revolution Glitch
presets.intent: HamloRevolution on a guitar part: experimental chops and filter motion.

presets.name: Guitar Lenin Amp Warmth
presets.intent: Guitar with BRING LENIN BACK and tape: warm amp-like body.

presets.name: Guitar Ping-Pong Delay
presets.intent: Lead guitar with a dotted ping-pong echo and plate.

presets.name: Guitar Tight Gate
presets.intent: High-gain rhythm: gate the noise, tight lows.

presets.name: Guitar Freeze Swell
presets.intent: Layers: layer 2 turns the guitar into a long swelling pad.

presets.name: Guitar Freeze Filter
presets.intent: Revolution freezes guitar moments while a smooth low-pass motion moves under them (mix 80 %).

presets.name: Acoustic Strum Even
presets.intent: Strummed acoustic even and full: boom held by a dynamic point, gentle opto-like compression.

presets.name: Piano Clear
presets.intent: Piano / keys clearer: low mids out, presence.

presets.name: Rhodes Tube Warmth
presets.intent: Electric piano: Tube saturation and a gentle wide chorus.

presets.name: Felt Lo-Fi Keys
presets.intent: Lo-fi felt keys: Vinyl crackle, dark, narrow.

presets.name: Keys Hall
presets.intent: Keys in a lush hall.

presets.name: Keys Freeze Pad
presets.intent: Layers: layer 2 freezes the keys into an endless reverb pad under the dry part.

presets.name: Keys Tape Wobble
presets.intent: Keys with cassette wow and flutter.

presets.name: Keys Ping-Pong Dream
presets.intent: Dreamy keys: ping-pong echo, cathedral, wide.

presets.name: Keys Revolution Chops
presets.intent: Revolution on keys: musical chops and repeats.

presets.name: Organ Stalin Grit
presets.intent: Organ / keys through STALIN: the transformer roar.

presets.name: Keys Crush Pulse
presets.intent: Revolution CRUSH motion on keys with tape under it: lo-fi bit pulses on the grid.

presets.name: Upright Piano Intimate
presets.intent: Close upright piano: warm low mids, felt-soft top, a small room.

presets.name: Synth Lead Cut
presets.intent: Lead synth through the mix: presence, tape drive, 1/8D echo.

presets.name: Pad Wide Soft
presets.intent: Pads: wide, soft, darker, in a hall.

presets.name: Pluck Ping-Pong
presets.intent: Plucks bouncing L-R on 1/8.

presets.name: Synth Motion Filter
presets.intent: HamloRevolution as an auto-filter: low-pass motion on the grid, no chops.

presets.name: Arp Destruction
presets.intent: Revolution DESTRUCTION on an arp: crush motion and glitches (mix 60 %).

presets.name: Synth Bass Growl
presets.intent: Synth bass: sub mono, growl saturation on a region above 250 Hz.

presets.name: Synth Lenin Analog
presets.intent: Synth with BRING LENIN BACK and Tube: analog-like.

presets.name: Synth Stereo Cosmos
presets.intent: Synth in KOSMOS: surround-like width, behind the speakers.

presets.name: Synth Tape Stop Fx
presets.intent: Revolution with only TIME: tape stops and half-time on a synth part.

presets.name: Synth Freeze Drone
presets.intent: Layers: the synth plus a long drone layer under it.

presets.name: Pad Volume Chops
presets.intent: Revolution VOLUME motion, hard edges: a pad chopped on 1/16 (trance-gate style).

presets.name: Synth Lead Double
presets.intent: Layers: the lead plus a pitched short double pushed wide.

presets.name: Mix Bus Glue
presets.intent: 2-bus glue: 2:1, slow attack, auto-release feel.

presets.name: Mix Bus Analog (Lenin)
presets.intent: Analog bus: tape and BRING LENIN BACK.

presets.name: Mix Bus Stalin Heat
presets.intent: BRING STALIN BACK at 50 %: transformer weight and harder harmonics.

presets.name: Mix Bus Air & Weight
presets.intent: Tilt-like: a low shelf and air shelf, wide but mono below 120 Hz.

presets.name: Mix Bus Multiband
presets.intent: Three regions: lows held, mids gentle, highs smoothed.

presets.name: Mix Bus Parallel Punch
presets.intent: Layers: layer 2 is a crushed copy of the mix blended in (New York style).

presets.name: Mix Bus Wide Mono-Safe
presets.intent: Wider mix, mono below 150 Hz, SAFE on.

presets.name: Mix Bus Tape 15 ips
presets.intent: Tape machine on the mix, gentle.

presets.name: Mix Bus Dynamic Mud
presets.intent: A dynamic point at 250 Hz cuts mud only when it builds up.

presets.name: Mix Bus Vintage Radio
presets.intent: The whole mix as an old radio: band-limited and STALIN.

presets.name: Mix Bus Low-End Focus
presets.intent: Low end tidy on the mix: mono below 100 Hz, a dynamic shelf on the boom, the top untouched.
